name: lyra-ui-workspace
description: Monorepo for @aceshooting/lyra-ui and its optional companion packages.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @aceshooting/lyra-ui run build && pnpm -r --filter '!@aceshooting/lyra-ui' --filter '!@aceshooting/lyra-map' --filter '!@aceshooting/lyra-3d' --if-present run build
scripts.test:benchmarks: node --test benchmarks/helpers.test.mjs benchmarks/gpu/run.test.mjs benchmarks/ab.test.mjs && node benchmarks/schema.mjs --check
scripts.docs:build: pnpm manifest:check && storybook build -o storybook-static && pnpm docs:sitemap
scripts.skill:check: node --test scripts/build-skill-bundle.test.mjs scripts/sync-plugin-version.test.mjs scripts/skill-reference-context.test.mjs scripts/check-task-context-budgets.test.mjs && node scripts/sync-plugin-version.mjs --check && node scripts/build-skill-bundle.mjs --check && node scripts/check-skill-manifest.mjs && node scripts/check-task-context-budgets.mjs
scripts.check:packed-consumer:contracts: pnpm run test:packed-consumer-tooling && node scripts/check-packed-consumer.mjs --skip-attw && node scripts/check-packed-framework-types.mjs && pnpm run check:framework-recipes
scripts.check:packed-consumer: pnpm run test:packed-consumer-tooling && node scripts/check-packed-consumer.mjs && node scripts/check-packed-framework-types.mjs && pnpm run check:framework-recipes
scripts.lint:oxlint: oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json --type-aware --deny-warnings packages/lyra-ui/src packages/lyra-3d/src packages/lyra-map/src && oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json --deny-warnings packages/lyra-ui/scripts packages/lyra-docs/scripts packages/lyra-3d/scripts packages/lyra-map/scripts packages/lyra-flags/scripts packages/lyra-ide/scripts packages/lyra-translations/scripts packages/lyra-ui/test packages/lyra-ui/type-tests packages/lyra-docs/test packages/lyra-map/test scripts benchmarks .storybook
scripts.check:release-tooling: node --test scripts/release-prepare.test.mjs scripts/release-integrity.test.mjs scripts/check-peer-compatibility.test.mjs scripts/check-node-version.test.mjs scripts/sync-package-manager-docs.test.mjs scripts/sync-playwright-images.test.mjs scripts/update-framework-recipe-versions.test.mjs scripts/ci-workflow-policy.test.mjs scripts/quality-tools.test.mjs scripts/release-sbom.test.mjs && node scripts/sync-package-manager-docs.mjs --check
scripts.release:budgets: pnpm --filter @aceshooting/lyra-ui run check:bundle-size && pnpm --filter @aceshooting/lyra-ui run check:package-size && node scripts/check-companion-package-sizes.mjs && node scripts/check-packed-consumer.mjs --skip-attw

sherif.//: maplibre-gl is pinned exactly in lyra-map on purpose: that package is built from the pinned upstream release, so its devDependency must not follow the caret range used by the root and lyra-ui.
